description: Allowlist and schema for Kyberion MCP facade tools (discover/act/govern bands, skill transfer, bounded actuator.invoke).

tools.name: kyberion.scope.current
tools.description: Resolve the effective scope, provenance, and positive knowledge roots.

tools.name: kyberion.knowledge.feedback
tools.description: Record human usefulness feedback for a knowledge document in the current scope.

tools.name: kyberion.pipeline.list
tools.description: List available Kyberion pipeline definitions.

tools.name: kyberion.pipeline.run
tools.description: Execute a named Kyberion pipeline by input path.
tools.notes: Only pipelines on the explicit allowlist may be run via MCP. Risky-op pipelines require approval gate. daily-routine is allowlisted as the operator daily journal/TODO path (local working-memory writes, not SaaS writes).

tools.name: kyberion.pipeline.job_status
tools.description: Poll a background pipeline job started via kyberion.pipeline.run (background: true).
tools.notes: Read-only status/output tail. Jobs are scoped to the MCP server session.

tools.name: kyberion.knowledge.search
tools.description: Search Kyberion knowledge base (public tier by default).
tools.notes: confidential tier requires explicit project scope grant via allowed_confidential_projects.

tools.name: kyberion.mission.create
tools.description: Create a new Kyberion mission.

tools.name: kyberion.mission.status
tools.description: Get the status of a Kyberion mission.

tools.name: kyberion.mission.journal
tools.description: Read the journal entries of a Kyberion mission.

tools.name: kyberion.capability.list
tools.description: List available Kyberion actuator capabilities.

tools.name: kyberion.capability.search
tools.description: Search the governed actuator capability catalog before loading an additional tool surface.
tools.notes: Deferred-tool discovery surface; results are descriptions only and do not execute an operation.

tools.name: kyberion.service.capture
tools.description: Execute a capture/read service preset (for example GitHub list/get issue or PR). Writes are rejected.
tools.notes: Capture-only. kind=capture and risk=read operations only. Writes stay on kyberion.service.actuate (approval-gated, disabled by default).

tools.name: kyberion.service.actuate
tools.description: Execute an allowlisted service actuator operation for a bound tenant.
tools.notes: Disabled by default; requires a server-bound tenant and an explicit service-actuation gate.

tools.name: kyberion.approval.list_pending
tools.description: List pending approval requests in Kyberion.

tools.name: kyberion.approval.decide
tools.description: Submit an approval decision (approve/reject) for a pending request.
tools.notes: Two-step required: list_pending first, then decide. Operator role only.

tools.name: kyberion.audit.export
tools.description: Export the audit chain for a mission.

tools.name: kyberion.surface.cowork.deliver
tools.description: Deliver a Kyberion artifact to the Cowork workspace.

tools.name: kyberion.surface.cowork.list
tools.description: List previously delivered artifacts in the Cowork outbox.

tools.name: kyberion.audit.verify
tools.description: Verify the integrity of the Kyberion audit chain (hash-linked). Returns pass/fail for tamper detection.

tools.name: kyberion.knowledge.cowork_sync
tools.description: Bidirectional knowledge sync between Cowork work-folder artifacts and Kyberion's knowledge base. Respects 3-tier isolation.
tools.notes: Only public tier knowledge flows to Cowork. Cowork artifacts are enqueued for memory promotion, never directly written to confidential/personal.

tools.name: kyberion.skill.list
tools.description: List transferable first-party Kyberion skills (SKILL.md) for MCP clients.
tools.notes: Skills are guides for LLMs; they are not executable tools by themselves.

tools.name: kyberion.skill.get
tools.description: Fetch a transferable skill body (SKILL.md) by plugin_id and skill_id.
tools.notes: Same content as MCP Resource kyberion://skill/{plugin}/{skill}.

tools.name: kyberion.actuator.invoke
tools.description: Invoke an allowlisted actuator op. Default mode is dry_run; live requires operator role.
tools.notes: Only pairs on actuator_invoke_allowlist. Prefer capability.search then invoke. Live writes may still require approval when the allowlist entry sets requires_approval.

actuator_invoke_allowlist.notes: Live path uses executeServicePreset; prefer service.capture for reads.
Dry-run validation only via MCP unless allowlist execution is raised later.
Dry-run validation of modeling-actuator pipeline op via MCP facade.
